title: Migrate fumadocs navigation from root:true to --- separator
body:
Fumadocs deprecated `root: true` for top-level menu sections. The new pattern uses `---` as an explicit separator in the parent navigation.

## Changes

- **Main navigation** (`content/docs/meta.json`): Added `---` separator before references section
- **References metadata** (`content/docs/references/meta.json`): Replaced `root: true` + `label` with `title`
- **Doc generator** (`packages/spec/scripts/build-docs.ts`): Updated to emit new format
- **`.gitignore`**: Added `package-lock.json` (project uses pnpm)

## Before/After

```diff
// content/docs/meta.json
  "pages": [
    "introduction",
    "objectql",
    "objectui",
    "objectos",
    "developers",
+   "---",
    "references"
  ]

// content/docs/references/meta.json
- "label": "Protocol Reference",
- "root": true,
+ "title": "Protocol Reference",
  "pages": [ ... ]
```
